verdict.rationale: Stark Bank is a regulated bank, so programmatic deposit-account opening is a fair question. However, the evidence never shows an API for applying for and activating an account. It shows only that account opening costs R$0/month, that a legal representative must register an Organization, and that Sandbox workspaces can be created self-serve. Nothing documents deposit insurance or an API-driven application-to-active flow. Sandbox self-serve signup and environment switching are adjacent, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a real, insured deposit account through the API — application to active account fully programmatic, with sandbox parity so the flow is tested before launch
